name: surfgate
description: Provider-neutral browser runtime router and control plane for AI agents

scripts.test:tasks: pnpm --filter @surfgate/contracts test && pnpm --filter @surfgate/config test && pnpm --filter @surfgate/task-core test && pnpm --filter @surfgate/object-storage test && pnpm --filter @surfgate/api test -- task && pnpm --filter @surfgate/worker test
scripts.test:security: pnpm --filter @surfgate/security test:security && pnpm --filter @surfgate/api test:security && pnpm --filter @surfgate/relay test:security
scripts.test:production-hardening: pnpm --filter @surfgate/config test && pnpm --filter @surfgate/api test -- reconciliation server && pnpm --filter @surfgate/relay test:security && pnpm --filter @surfgate/worker test -- lifecycle health-server
scripts.test:recovery: pnpm --filter @surfgate/api test -- reconciliation && pnpm --filter @surfgate/worker test -- managed-task-worker
scripts.test:capacity: pnpm --filter @surfgate/router test -- golden invariants && pnpm --filter @surfgate/api test -- session-service && pnpm --filter @surfgate/worker test -- managed-task-worker && pnpm test:relay-load
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.release:check: pnpm check && pnpm test:security && pnpm test:observability && pnpm test:production-hardening && pnpm test:tasks && pnpm test:integration && pnpm test:conformance
